cohort: 1,511 patients who gave birth to singletons after undergoing frozen-thawed blastocyst transfer (FBT) cycles at the Gynecological Endocrinology and Assisted Reproduction Center of the Peking Union Medical College Hospital
finding: Cryopreservation duration after blastocyst vitrification for more than 2 years did not have a significant effect on the birth-weight of FBT singletons.
